en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
Attributes of gurmukhs - the guru oriented

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੁਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਚੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh hovai saadhasa(n)g horat sa(n)g kusa(n)g na rachai|

en.bdb: The person having attained the status of Gurmukh in the holy  congregation does not mix up with any bad company.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲੜਾ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਨ ਖੇਚਲ ਖਚੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th suhelaRaa baareh pa(n)th na khechal khachai|

en.bdb: The way (life) of  Gurmukh is simple and enjoyable; he does not enrapt himself with the  concerns of the twelve sects (of yogis).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਪਰਚੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh varan avaran hoi ra(n)g sura(n)g ta(n)bol parachai|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs go beyond the castes,  colours and go about in equanimity like the red colour of betel leaf.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਣ ਨ ਸਰਚੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh dharasan dhekhanaa chhia dharasan parasan na sarachai|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs behold the Guru's school and put no faith in six Schools (of  Indian tradition).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲੁਭਾਇ ਨ ਪਚੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh nihachal mat hai dhoojai bhai lubhai na pachai|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs have steadfast wisdom and do not waste  themselves in the fire of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਹਚੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sabadh kamaavanaa pairee pai raharaas na hachai|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs practise the (Guru) shabad and  never forsake the exercise of touching the feet, i.e.they never abandon  humility.
